title: SDK hello-world failures and fixes standup 2026-08-26
content:
Meeting: DevExp standup — focused on hello-world quickstart smoke failures
Date: 2026-08-26
Facilitator: Marisol Vega
Attendees: Marisol, Liam, Priya, Owen, Zoe (notes), +2 async
Duration: 30m

Agenda:
- Quick sync on recent smoke-test regressions for the JavaScript and Python hello-world quickstarts
- Root cause updates and temporary mitigations for docs/SDK mismatches
- Release / rollout decision for patched quickstart images
- Action items and owners for follow-ups (docs, tests, CI)

Summary / TL;DR:
The smoke harness began failing ~2026-08-19 after the runtime tiled KV-cache change (serving-runtime rollout v1.14). Failures are concentrated in the sample apps that use socket-streaming + function-calls pattern in the JS SDK. Root cause: minor change to stream-chunk framing + an undocumented optional `session_token` header in the hosted API that the quickstarts didn't set; combined with overly strict example test assertions. Two immediate fixes are in flight: (1) SDK patch to be backwards tolerant to the new framing (PR #412), and (2) docs update to surface `session_token` and update examples (confluence page + quickstart README). We recommend a staged re-run of smoke tests after merging the SDK patch.

Notes / details:
- Failure pattern: tests intermittently hang on first streaming token; sometimes an error 'invalid-framing' bubbled up from the runtime. Repro steps in LINEAR-887 outline a reproducible local repro on macOS with node 18.
- Root cause deep dive (Liam): the runtime introduced a 1-byte prefix that the SDK previously ignored; new kernel path validates prefixes stricter when streaming and the SDK's parser threw on unexpected leading bytes. The JS SDK parser assumed no prefix. The Python SDK used a streaming iterator that tolerated the new bytes and mostly passed.
- Header drift: a recent infra change added an optional `x-rw-session-token` header for routing sticky-cache keys for experiments. Quickstarts didn't include this header, and the hosted API responded with a redirect-variant that the old examples didn't handle. This only surfaced with certain regional routing combos (us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 fallback).
- Tests were too brittle: smoke harness asserted exact token sequences (including whitespace/trailing newlines). We need to make them assertion-tolerant (token contains intent words rather than exact match).

Decisions made:
- Merge SDK PR #412 (JS tolerant parser) to main after one approving review from Priya. Ship as a patch release 0.14.3. Tag: release/sdks/0.14.3.
- Docs: add a \"Networking and tokens\" subsection to quickstart README; surface `x-rw-session-token` as optional but recommended for some Dedicated setups. Priya to author.
- CI: add a flaky-tolerant streaming smoke test harness that retries once on timeout and uses substring assertions rather than strict equality. Owen to add to CI (github actions) and to the smoke runner.
- Rollout plan: merge SDK patch -> trigger nightly smoke; if nightly passes 3 consecutive runs, promote quickstart image to public docs site and pin samples to SDK 0.14.3. If failures remain, revert to pinned older runtime-compatible example in docs and open broader runtime compatibility queue.

Action items (owner — due):
- Priya: finalize PR review and merge SDK JS patch (#412). Due 2026-08-27 EOD.
- Owen: update GH actions smoke workflow to do 1 retry on streaming timeout and update assertion logic. Add short note in PR describing flakiness heuristics. Due 2026-08-28 morning.
- Marisol: update the quickstart README + confluence checklist to add session_token guidance and a short troubleshooting section. Draft due 2026-08-27.
- Zoe: run manual cross-region smoke on staging (us-west-2 -> eu-west-1) and record request/response traces; attach to LINEAR-887. Due 2026-08-27.
- Liam: file a small runtime playbook ticket to add a compatibility toggle for stream-framing behavior (so older SDKs remain compatible) and link to release notes. LINEAR-892 created. Due 2026-09-03.
- All: validate that examples in the quickstart use npm install @redwood/sdk@0.14.3 (once released) and update sample-repo. Responsible: Priya + Marisol. Due 2026-08-30.

Risks / open questions:
- Does the `x-rw-session-token` have any PII implications? Security should weigh in. ACTION: Marisol to loop in security (cc: security@redwood.ai) for sign-off on docs wording (by 2026-08-29).
- Are there other SDKs (Ruby/Go) with similar streaming parsers? Quick audit needed. ACTION: Owen to open a checklist and ping maintainers.
- Longer-term: we should formalize a streaming contract document that enumerates framing, headers, and retry semantics. Suggestion: make this a short RFC in the serving-runtime repo and link from SDK READMEs. Volunteer: Liam.

Notes to self / informal TODOs (copied from meeting ramble):
- quick checklist: smoke harness -> tolerant assertions -> merge SDK -> nightlies -> manual cross-region -> promote docs
- keep release message explicit: \"fix: tolerate runtime framing in JS SDK; update quickstart examples\"; include regression test note
- check GH PR template for SDK to include a \"compatibility impact\" field (helps catch this sooner)

Follow-ups scheduled:
- Brief async standup in #devexp at 10:00 PT on 2026-08-27 for status updates.
- Short retro/lessons-learned session Tues 2026-09-02 11:00 PT — capture in Confluence and add to onboarding notes.

Attachments / artifacts referenced:
- Repro script (attached to LINEAR-887) — run with NODE_ENV=staging and RW_API_HOST=staging-host
- github PR 412 (sdk JS tolerant parser) — includes unit + integration test adjustments
- Confluence quickstart checklist (draft) — link in metadata above

End notes:
- This was a useful reminder that small infra signaling changes can cascade into sample/docs breakage quickly. Need better smoke coverage for streaming + cross-region combos.
- Good collaboration: dev + docs + infra lanes moved quickly. Keep momentum on the fixes and get the patched quickstart live by end of next week if all tests pass.

-- Marisol
